assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All precise locational, area and regulatory conclusions must be recomputed from official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, ownership, road redlines, existing-building data, utilities, fire, heritage and engineering constraints are absent from the public package.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, setback, renewal, construction or approval conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Toolroom operators, facilities, service agreements and activity permits are not identified by this concept package.
assumptions.impact: All operational roles are prototypes only.

assumptions.statement: Any collection beyond the stated minimum requires separate data-protection, accessibility and security review.
assumptions.impact: Default scenarios retain no persistent personal data.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility design must be co-reviewed with affected users and licensed professionals.
assumptions.impact: Paper, staff and non-digital alternatives remain mandatory design conditions.
